reviews: [★5] Terrific purchase - The 48MP main camera is a massive leap forward from previous generations, capturing stunning dynamic range and detail even in low-light environments.
[★5] Best in class display - The Dynamic Island is genuinely useful for tracking deliveries and music playback, and the 2000-nit peak outdoor brightness is crystal clear in direct sunlight.
[★5] USB-C transition is seamless - Finally one cable for MacBook, iPad, and iPhone. Transfer speeds are fine for daily photos and charging is dependable.
[★5] Premium matte texture - The color-infused back glass with contoured edges feels significantly more comfortable in hand without slipping compared to sharp aluminum rails.
[★5] Remarkable battery endurance - Easily lasts an entire day of heavy photography, WhatsApp video calls, and navigation with 25% remaining at bedtime.
[★5] Incredible portrait mode - The automatic depth capture without manually toggling Portrait mode makes snapping impromptu candid shots effortless.
[★5] Superb stereo audio - Loud, punchy stereo speakers with great separation and clear dialogue for podcasts and Netflix streaming.
[★5] Outstanding performance - The A16 Bionic chip handles high-framerate gaming and heavy multitasking without stuttering or thermal throttling.
[★5] Crisp selfies - Front camera autofocus produces razor-sharp selfies and FaceTime video clarity is unmatched by any Android competitor.
[★5] Highly durable build - Ceramic Shield front glass took a couple of accidental coffee table drops with zero scratches or cracks.
[★5] Intuitive iOS experience - Fluid animations and seamless AirDrop file transfers to Mac make productivity so much faster.
[★5] Solid haptics and vibration - The Taptic Engine delivers subtle, refined keyboard click feedback that feels tactile and satisfying.
[★5] Compact and lightweight - Weighs only 171 grams, making it one of the most pocketable and ergonomic flagship smartphones available.
[★5] Cinematic video quality - 4K 60fps Dolby Vision HDR recording produces professional looking video clips with unmatched stabilization.
[★5] Reliable 5G reception - Excellent signal strength on Airtel 5G with consistent high-speed data throughput even in basements.
[★5] Value deal on Flipkart - Snagged during Big Billion Days with card offers at a very attractive price point. Highly recommended.
[★5] Gorgeous black finish - The subtle satin matte black looks stealthy, executive, and resists fingerprint smudges remarkably well.
[★5] Long-term software support - Guaranteed 5+ years of iOS updates gives total peace of mind for longevity and resale value.
[★4] Solid upgrade from iPhone 11 - Noticeably faster camera shutter and brighter screen, though lacks 120Hz ProMotion display.
[★4] Very good daily driver - Beautiful photos and great build quality, but charging speed tops out at around 20W which feels sluggish in 2026.
[★4] Impressive cameras but no optical telephoto - 2x crop zoom is sharp, but beyond 5x digital zoom images start losing fine detail.
[★4] Great performance but warms up slightly - Gets warm around the camera module during extended 4K video recording sessions in summer.
[★4] Premium phone - Everything works smoothly as expected. Wish Apple included a fast charger in the box for the price paid.
[★4] Smooth UI experience - iOS is snappy and clean with zero bloatware, though customization options remain limited compared to Android.
[★4] Good sound and display - Vibrant colors for HDR content, but the 60Hz refresh rate is noticeable when side-by-side with 120Hz panels.
[★3] Decent phone held back by 60Hz screen - At this price point, a 60Hz refresh rate panel is difficult to justify when budget phones offer 120Hz.
[★3] Average charging speed - Takes nearly 90 minutes to reach full charge with a 20W adapter, which lags behind competitors.
[★2] Overheating while fast charging - Device becomes uncomfortably hot to the touch when charging with a 30W PD charger.
[★2] Slow USB 2.0 data transfer - Transferring large 4K video files over the included USB-C cable takes forever due to USB 2.0 speed limit.
[★1] Disappointing battery health drop - Battery maximum capacity dropped to 96% within just three months of moderate daily use.
